summary: UNDOS: mint opens Fri 20:00 - link in chat
text: The UNDOS team says the community mint opens Friday at 20:00 UTC. The allowlist checker is live now; verify your wallet before the window. The team says the mint link will be pinned in the official chat.
The REACT governance snapshot is now scheduled for November 24 at 12:00 UTC. The team says no action is needed; balances at the snapshot time determine eligibility.
A regional RPC provider plans maintenance from 03:00 to 03:20 UTC. Requests may retry during the window.
